queries.sql: SELECT o.country, SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS revenue_eur FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN returns r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.country ORDER BY o.country

WITH line AS (
  SELECT o.order_id,
         DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o.order_date) AS qtr,
         (oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur AS net_rev
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  LEFT JOIN returns r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-10-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-04-01'
)
SELECT qtr, SUM(net_rev) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count, SUM(net_rev)/COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS aov
FROM line GROUP BY qtr ORDER BY qtr

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', order_date) AS qtr, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS completed_orders FROM orders WHERE status='completed' AND order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY qtr ORDER BY qtr
SELECT COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON s.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.country = 'Belgium'

SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty_all, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status='completed' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS total_qty_completed FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

WITH line AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o.order_date) AS qtr,
    oi.quantity, COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0) AS qty_ret,
    (oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur AS net_rev,
    oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * o.fx_rate_to_eur AS gross_rev_list
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  LEFT JOIN returns r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
  WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.country='France' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-10-01'
)
SELECT qtr, SUM(net_rev) AS net_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders, SUM(quantity) AS qty_ordered, SUM(qty_ret) AS qty_returned, SUM(qty_ret)*1.0/SUM(quantity) AS return_rate
FROM line GROUP BY qtr ORDER BY qtr

SELECT r.reason, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS qty
FROM returns r
JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.country='France' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-10-01'
GROUP BY r.reason ORDER BY qty DESC

SELECT r.reason, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS qty
FROM returns r
JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.country='France' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-07-01'
GROUP BY r.reason ORDER BY qty DESC

WITH line AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.customer_id,
    (oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur AS net_rev
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  LEFT JOIN returns r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
  WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.country='France' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-10-01'
),
seg AS (
  SELECT l.*, cs.segment
  FROM line l
  LEFT JOIN customer_segments cs
    ON cs.customer_id = l.customer_id
    AND cs.valid_from <= l.order_date
    AND (cs.valid_to IS NULL OR l.order_date < cs.valid_to)
)
SELECT COALESCE(segment,'unknown') AS segment, SUM(net_rev) AS revenue
FROM seg GROUP BY segment ORDER BY segment

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o.order_date) AS qtr,
  SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS net_revenue,
  SUM(oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) AS net_units,
  SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)),0) AS rev_per_unit
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN returns r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
WHERE o.status='completed' AND p.category='Kitchenware'
GROUP BY qtr ORDER BY qtr

SELECT pp.product_id, pp.unit_price, pp.unit_cost, pp.valid_from, pp.valid_to
FROM product_pricing pp
JOIN products p ON pp.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.category='Kitchenware'
ORDER BY pp.product_id, pp.valid_from
SELECT MIN(order_date), MAX(order_date) FROM orders

SELECT strftime(o.order_date, '%Y') AS yr, SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS revenue_eur, SUM(oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) AS net_units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE p.category = 'Kitchenware' AND o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT strftime(o.order_date, '%Y-Q') || CAST(((CAST(strftime(o.order_date,'%m') AS INT)-1)/3+1) AS VARCHAR) AS qtr, SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS revenue_eur, SUM(oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) AS net_units, AVG(oi.line_discount_pct) as avg_discount FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE p.category = 'Kitchenware' AND o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT p.product_id, p.name, pp.unit_price, pp.valid_from, pp.valid_to FROM product_pricing pp JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pp.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Kitchenware' ORDER BY p.product_id, pp.valid_from

SELECT strftime(o.order_date,'%Y') yr, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) net_units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id=oi.order_item_id WHERE p.category='Kitchenware' AND o.status='completed' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

WITH order_rev AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date,
    SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id

),
ship_counts AS (

)
SELECT strftime(orr.order_date,'%Y') yr, COUNT(*) n_orders, AVG(orr.revenue_eur / sc.n_shipments) avg_revenue_per_shipment
FROM order_rev orr
JOIN ship_counts sc ON sc.order_id = orr.order_id
WHERE sc.n_shipments > 1
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH order_rev AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date,
    SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
ship_counts AS (
  SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS n_shipments FROM shipments GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT strftime(orr.order_date,'%Y') || '-H' || CASE WHEN CAST(strftime(orr.order_date,'%m') AS INT)<=6 THEN '1' ELSE '2' END half, COUNT(*) n_orders, AVG(orr.revenue_eur / sc.n_shipments) avg_revenue_per_shipment
FROM order_rev orr
JOIN ship_counts sc ON sc.order_id = orr.order_id
WHERE sc.n_shipments > 1
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT o.country, SUM(COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0))*1.0/SUM(oi.quantity) AS return_rate, SUM(oi.quantity) total_units
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT strftime(o.order_date,'%Y') yr, CAST((CAST(strftime(o.order_date,'%m') AS INT)-1)/3+1 AS INT) q,
SUM(COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0))*1.0/SUM(oi.quantity) AS return_rate, SUM(oi.quantity) total_units
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
WHERE o.country = 'France'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT date_trunc('quarter', o.order_date) qtr,
SUM(COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0))*1.0/SUM(oi.quantity) AS return_rate, SUM(oi.quantity) total_units
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
WHERE o.country = 'France'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH base AS (
  SELECT o.country,
    SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS revenue,
    SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_cost * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS net_cost,
    AVG(oi.line_discount_pct) avg_discount
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.status='completed'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT country, revenue, net_cost, (revenue-net_cost)/NULLIF(revenue,0) margin, avg_discount FROM base
UNION ALL
SELECT 'TOTAL', SUM(revenue), SUM(net_cost), (SUM(revenue)-SUM(net_cost))/NULLIF(SUM(revenue),0), NULL FROM base

WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS revenue,
    SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_cost * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS undiscounted_cost
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.country = 'France'
)
SELECT revenue, undiscounted_cost, (revenue-undiscounted_cost)/revenue AS margin_if_cost_not_discounted FROM base

WITH seg AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.fx_rate_to_eur, o.status, cs.segment
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customer_segments cs ON cs.customer_id = o.customer_id
    AND cs.valid_from <= o.order_date AND (cs.valid_to IS NULL OR o.order_date < cs.valid_to)
)
SELECT s.segment,
  SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * s.fx_rate_to_eur) AS revenue,
  SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_cost * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * s.fx_rate_to_eur) AS net_cost
FROM order_items oi
JOIN seg s ON s.order_id = oi.order_id
LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
WHERE s.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY 1

WITH seg AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.fx_rate_to_eur, o.status, cs.segment
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customer_segments cs ON cs.customer_id = o.customer_id
    AND cs.valid_from <= o.order_date AND (cs.valid_to IS NULL OR o.order_date < cs.valid_to)
)
SELECT s.segment,
  SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * s.fx_rate_to_eur) AS revenue,
  SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_cost * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * s.fx_rate_to_eur) AS net_cost,
  (SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * s.fx_rate_to_eur) - SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_cost * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * s.fx_rate_to_eur)) / NULLIF(SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * s.fx_rate_to_eur),0) AS margin,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) n_orders
FROM order_items oi
JOIN seg s ON s.order_id = oi.order_id
LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
WHERE s.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY 1

WITH order_fin AS (
  SELECT o.order_id,
    SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS revenue,
    SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_cost * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS net_cost
  FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY 1
),
ship_counts AS (
  SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) n_shipments FROM shipments GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT CASE WHEN sc.n_shipments >= 2 THEN 'split (2+)' ELSE 'single' END AS fulfillment_type,
  COUNT(*) n_orders,
  AVG(revenue) avg_revenue,
  AVG(net_cost) avg_net_cost,
  (SUM(revenue)-SUM(net_cost))/NULLIF(SUM(revenue),0) margin
FROM order_fin f
JOIN ship_counts sc ON sc.order_id = f.order_id
GROUP BY 1

WITH base AS (
  SELECT o.country, strftime(o.order_date,'%Y') yr,
    SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS revenue,
    SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_cost * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS net_cost,
    SUM(COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) rtn_units, SUM(oi.quantity) tot_units,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) n_orders
  FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id=oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.status='completed'
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT country, yr, revenue, (revenue-net_cost)/NULLIF(revenue,0) margin, rtn_units*1.0/tot_units return_rate, n_orders
FROM base ORDER BY country, yr

SELECT country, MIN(fx_rate_to_eur) min_fx, MAX(fx_rate_to_eur) max_fx, AVG(fx_rate_to_eur) avg_fx
FROM orders WHERE country='Switzerland' GROUP BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('quarter', o.order_date) qtr, o.status, COUNT(*) n_orders
FROM orders o WHERE o.country='France'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.country,
  SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS net_revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
WHERE o.status='completed' AND strftime(o.order_date,'%Y')='2025'
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH cust AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, c.name,
    SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS revenue,
    SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_cost * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS net_cost
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.status='completed'
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT COUNT(*) total_customers,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (revenue-net_cost)/NULLIF(revenue,0) > 0.20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) above_20pct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (revenue-net_cost)/NULLIF(revenue,0) <= 0.20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) at_or_below_20pct,
  MIN((revenue-net_cost)/NULLIF(revenue,0)) min_margin,
  MAX((revenue-net_cost)/NULLIF(revenue,0)) max_margin
FROM cust

SELECT p.category,
  SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS revenue,
  SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_cost * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS net_cost,
  (SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) - SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_cost * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur)) / NULLIF(SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur),0) AS margin
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY margin DESC
SELECT segment, COUNT(*) FROM customer_segments WHERE valid_to IS NULL GROUP BY 1

WITH cur_seg AS (
  SELECT customer_id, segment FROM customer_segments WHERE valid_to IS NULL
),
cust_stats AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, cs.segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) n_orders,
    SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS total_revenue
  FROM customers c
  JOIN cur_seg cs ON cs.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status='completed'
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT segment, COUNT(*) n_cust, AVG(n_orders) avg_orders, AVG(total_revenue) avg_revenue, AVG(total_revenue/NULLIF(n_orders,0)) avg_aov
FROM cust_stats GROUP BY 1

WITH cur_seg AS (
  SELECT customer_id, segment FROM customer_segments WHERE valid_to IS NULL
),
cust_stats AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, cs.segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) n_orders,
    SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS total_revenue,
    MAX(o.order_date) last_order
  FROM customers c
  JOIN cur_seg cs ON cs.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status='completed'
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT segment,
  quantile_cont(n_orders,0.25) q25_orders, quantile_cont(n_orders,0.5) med_orders,
  quantile_cont(total_revenue,0.25) q25_rev, quantile_cont(total_revenue,0.5) med_rev
FROM cust_stats GROUP BY 1

WITH cur_seg AS (SELECT customer_id, segment FROM customer_segments WHERE valid_to IS NULL),
cust_stats AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.country, cs.segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) n_orders,
    SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS total_revenue
  FROM customers c JOIN cur_seg cs ON cs.customer_id=c.customer_id
  JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id AND o.status='completed'
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id
  LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id=oi.order_item_id
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
)
SELECT customer_id, name, country, n_orders, total_revenue FROM cust_stats
WHERE segment='standard' ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10

WITH base AS (
  SELECT o.country,
    SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS revenue,
    SUM((oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) * oi.unit_cost * (1 - oi.line_discount_pct) * o.fx_rate_to_eur) AS net_cost,
    SUM(COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0)) rtn_units, SUM(oi.quantity) tot_units,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) n_orders
  FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id=oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.status='completed' AND strftime(o.order_date,'%Y')='2025'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT country, revenue, (revenue-net_cost)/NULLIF(revenue,0) margin, rtn_units*1.0/tot_units return_rate, n_orders, revenue/NULLIF(n_orders,0) aov
FROM base ORDER BY return_rate DESC

Two supporting points: (1) Under Sahara Retail's accounting convention (see discount_cost_policy), a discount is applied proportionally to both price and cost, so the margin *ratio* for a given product is mathematically invariant to discount depth (margin = (price-cost)/price, the (1-discount) factor cancels) -- meaning deeper discounts alone don't mechanically erode the reported margin percentage at all. So under either accounting treatment, Sahara Retail could increase discounts significantly for French customers before overall margin would approach 20%; the real constraint is not margin capacity but how much volume/return-rate response the added discount generates (especially relevant given France's currently elevated Q3 2025 return-rate anomaly).

answers.answer: Under Sahara Retail's accounting convention, a discount is applied proportionally to both price and cost (see discount_cost_policy), so a product/customer's margin RATIO is mathematically invariant to discount depth: margin = (price - cost)/price, and the (1 - discount) factor cancels out of both revenue and cost. This means offering an ADDITIONAL 10% discount does not by itself change the margin percentage for any customer -- what matters is each customer's underlying (undiscounted) product margin. Checking all 300 customers' current margins: every single one is already well above 20%, ranging from a minimum of 48.5% to a maximum of 59.4% (all-customer average ~54.9%). So the answer is: all 300 customers could be offered a 10% discount while keeping margin above 20% -- there is no customer close to the 20% threshold, and margin is structurally unaffected by discount depth under this accounting convention. (If instead cost were NOT discounted along with price -- i.e., a stricter economic view -- a 10% discount would reduce margin by roughly cost/revenue * 10 percentage points for each customer, which given the ~45% average cost-to-revenue ratio would still leave essentially all customers comfortably above 20%, since minimum margin of 48.5% has ample cushion.)

Recommendation -- prioritize fixing France first. Margin is essentially uniform across all four markets (54.5%-55.1%, a <1-point spread), so margin is not a differentiator; the standout problem is France's return rate of 14.2%, roughly 4x every other market's ~3.4-3.5% baseline, concentrated in a Q3 2025 fulfillment-delay spike (46.6% of units returned that quarter alone -- see Q10). France is also Sahara Retail's largest market by revenue, so the same elevated return rate destroys the most absolute value there and the fix has the highest leverage. Germany, Belgium, and Switzerland all look healthy and comparable to one another on both margin and return rate and do not require urgent intervention; France is the clear, isolated outlier and should be the regional manager's top priority.
